eur_per_deg_c.note: free recovered material in the demo (cost_total_eur = 0.0); €/°C is a PLACEHOLDER, NOT a real 0 €/°C. Computes normally once a non-zero Phase-5 cost_total_eur lands.

baseline_conditions.sky_albedo: ASSUMED (infrared.city radiation-based model assumptions; see acceptance/baseline_spec.md)

predicted_vs_measured.monitoring_protocol: ISO 7726: globe thermometer + air-temperature/RH probes at 1.1 m; stations at canopy centre, canopy edge, and an unshaded control; 5-min logging; raw CSV published open. measured_utci_delta_c stays null until a real on-site campaign lands — never fabricated.

provenance_labels.comfort_gap_note: = utci_delta_c / (baseline_mean_c − 26) × 100; % of the (UTCI − 26) comfort gap closed over the target shaded cells.
